issues.display_title: Issue #188: Store the user's GoThru API token at GoThru sign-in and proxy Blue Line reads
issues.main_description_html:
Assigned to: Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

Follow-up to #182 (Continue with GoThru). FE counterpart: GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1104.

The Blue Line dashboard and editor (PRD GoThruMedia/gothru-3d-floormap#1082, fixtures only since #1092) now have real read endpoints on the GoThru API (GoThru-API-New, handed over by the GoThru backend team on 2026-09-24). All three authenticate with the user's GoThru API token (gt.<jwt>), and Floormap doesn't have one. This task gets that token when the user signs in with GoThru, stores it encrypted, and exposes the three reads to the FE through this API. The FE never sees the token.

⚠️ API contract change: two new columns on user_keycloak_links and three new authenticated endpoints.

Upstream endpoints

Checked on GoThru API main 92cce80fd; Bruno collection api-collection/GoThru API NEW/User/Tours/.

Endpoint Scope Returns (data)
POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login, body {"token": "<Keycloak access token>"} public token = gt.<jwt>, TTL 30 days (KeycloakLoginAction)
GET /v1/tours/list?page&limit&search&sort_by&type=blueline caller's tours list_tours[] (moderation_id, tour_key, business_name, thumb, total_panorama, place_id, place_address, lat, lng, last_save, publish_status, blueline_error, archived, …) + pagination
GET /v1/panoramas/locations?mid caller's tour (m.user_id) panoramas[] (id, lat/lng as strings, fid, sequence, is_vslide); no limit = all
GET /v2/panoramas/links?mid any valid token (no ownership check) links: [[[lng,lat],[lng,lat]], …] — always encrypted
  • The auth header is the raw token: Authorization: gt.<jwt>, with no Bearer. GoThru strips only the gt. prefix.
  • Responses are encrypted unless the request sends the header enc: false (global NormalizeEncryptFlag). /v2/panoramas/links ignores that header; see Decryption.
  • GT tokens are stateless JWTs, revoked through a Redis denylist. Getting one here doesn't sign the user out of other GoThru apps, and a Keycloak logout doesn't revoke it.

Scope

  1. Migration: add gt_token_enc TEXT NULL and gt_token_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NULL to user_keycloak_links.
  2. Exchange at sign-in (POST /v1/auth/keycloak, after the user is resolved): send the same Keycloak access token to {GOTHRU_API_BASE}/v1/auth/keycloak-login as {"token": …} (the field is token, not access_token). Take data.token, read exp from its payload, encrypt it, and store it on the link row.
    • Best-effort. Log any failure with the status only, never the token: GoThru down, 401 because floormap isn't an allowed client yet, an account conflict, an inactive GoThru user. The Floormap sign-in still succeeds. Use a short timeout (5 s) so a slow GoThru API can't stall login.
    • Every GoThru sign-in overwrites the stored token, so signing in again is how a user reconnects.
  3. Encryption: AES-256-GCM with a key derived by HKDF from JWT_SECRET. Reuse src/utils/project_password.go (#184) with its own info string, e.g. gothru-gt-token-v1. A value that doesn't decrypt (for example after JWT_SECRET rotates) counts as not connected.
  4. Proxy endpoints behind middleware.Auth(). Each one loads the caller's token from their link row:
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours?page&limit&search&sort_by&type → /v1/tours/list
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas → /v1/panoramas/locations?mid=
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/links → /v2/panoramas/links?mid=, decrypted here. GoThru doesn't check who owns the tour on this route, so check first: call /v1/panoramas/locations?mid=&limit=1 (scoped to the caller) and answer 404 when it's empty. Otherwise this proxy would pass the hole through.
    • :mid must be a positive integer. Forward only the listed query params, URL-encoded.
    • Response: GoThru's data object, unchanged, inside this API's usual envelope.
    • Errors:
      • no link, no token, expired or undecryptable → 409 gothru_not_connected
      • GoThru answers 401 → clear the stored token, then 409 gothru_not_connected
      • GoThru unreachable or 5xx → 502
      • any other GoThru 4xx → same status
  5. Env: GOTHRU_API_BASE=http://192.168.1.177, the LAN address the FE tour import already uses (PANORAMAS_API_BASE). Don't use https://apil.gothru.co: it resolves to the public 208.76.107.71, the same hairpin-NAT setup that broke the JWKS fetch to id.gothru.org (#187). Checked from 192.168.2.15: 1.177 answers all four routes (401/409 without a token). Not checked from 1.226.

Decryption (/v2/panoramas/links)

Preferred: GoThru honours enc on this endpoint the way its v1 siblings do. PanoramasController@getPanoramaLinksV2 calls encryptResult unconditionally; with that fixed, no crypto is needed here. Until then, port HelperClass::encryptResult (app/Class/HelperClass.php:609) in reverse:

  • Split data.ls (e.g. 2026-09-25T10:11:12.123456+07:00) into Y m d H i s. Then formula = ((H*d) XOR 1) + ((i*d) XOR 1) + s*d + int("Ym"). This follows PHP precedence: $hours * $day ^ 3 / 3 is (H*d) ^ (3/3).
  • password = e4[:5] + str(formula) + e4[5:]
  • key = PBKDF2-SHA512(password, salt = hexdecode(su1fur), 999 iterations), first 32 bytes. hash_pbkdf2(..., 64) returns 64 hex characters.
  • AES-256-CBC with iv = hexdecode(f0ur), ciphertext base64decode(c1p), PKCS#7 padding. The result is JSON { "links": …, "messages": … }.
  • Test against a real captured response, not just a round trip through our own port.

Dependencies

  • The GoThru API deployment adds floormap,floormap-dev to KEYCLOAK_ALLOWED_CLIENTS (default app-gothru,gothru-dashboard,app-gothru-local). Without it step 2 always gets 401. Sign-in still works, but the proxies answer 409.
  • (Optional) GoThru honours enc: false and checks tour ownership on /v2/panoramas/links.
  • Apply the migration to the shared DB before merging to development. Merging deploys to 192.168.1.226, and deploy runs no migrations.
  • Add GOTHRU_API_BASE to the server .env, then restart.

Out of scope

  • Writing panorama positions. The GoThru API has no endpoint for it (PRD R28 is still blocked).
  • A separate "connect" endpoint for users who signed up with email/password. Signing in once with GoThru links their account (verified-email match, #182).
  • Keycloak refresh tokens. They aren't stored: the GT token lives 30 days, and after that the user signs in with GoThru again.

Acceptance criteria

  • A GoThru sign-in stores an encrypted GT token and its expiry on the link row. The DB never holds it in plaintext and logs never print it.
  • A GoThru API failure during sign-in still returns a Floormap session.
  • The three proxies return GoThru's data for the caller's own tours, and links come back decrypted.
  • Links for a tour the caller doesn't own → 404.
  • No token, expired or undecryptable → 409 gothru_not_connected. An upstream 401 clears the token.
  • A non-numeric :mid → 400, and nothing is sent upstream.
  • Tests run against an httptest GoThru stub: exchange succeeds, exchange fails, a 401 clears the token, and a real captured /v2/panoramas/links response decrypts.
  • go test ./... green.

RESULT

Implemented and merged. development at b89c5e5: go build ./..., go vet ./... and go test ./... all pass.

What changed

  • Migration migrations/202609250001_add_gothru_token_to_user_keycloak_links.sql adds gothru_token_enc TEXT and gothru_token_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ to user_keycloak_links. These are named gothru_* rather than the gt_token_* names in the spec.
  • Exchange at sign-in: gothru.Connect (src/action/v1/gothru/token.go) is called from src/action/v1/auth/keycloak.go after the user is resolved.
    • It sends the Keycloak access token to {GOTHRU_API_BASE}/v1/auth/keycloak-login with a 5 s timeout, and reads exp from the unverified GT JWT.
    • It is best-effort: a failure is logged without the token, and the sign-in still succeeds. If GOTHRU_API_BASE is unset, it does nothing.
  • Encryption: src/utils/gothru_token.go uses AES-GCM with an HKDF key from JWT_SECRET (info gothru-gt-token-v1, bound to the user), and reuses the #184 helpers.
  • Proxies (src/action/v1/gothru/proxy.go, src/routes/v1/gothru.go, behind middleware.Auth()):
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours → /v1/tours/list (forwards only page, limit, search, sort_by, type)
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/panoramas → /v1/panoramas/locations
    • GET /v1/gothru/tours/:mid/links → /v2/panoramas/links, decrypted here. Ownership is checked first through /v1/panoramas/locations?limit=1, and the proxy answers 404 when the caller has no panorama in that tour.
    • Error mapping follows the spec: 409 gothru_not_connected; an upstream 401 clears the token and returns 409; unreachable or 5xx → 502; any other 4xx passes through; a non-numeric :mid → 400 without calling GoThru.
  • Decryption: src/action/v1/gothru/decrypt.go is a Go port of HelperClass::encryptResult. It is tested against a real captured GoThru response.
  • Follow-ups:
    • GoThru responses start with a UTF-8 BOM, which is now stripped before decoding (#191).
    • When a proxy read fails, the log now says what GoThru answered, without the token (#193).

PRs

  • development: #189 (77ecef5), #191 (16740b9), #193 (2019077)
  • Released to main: #190 and #192. #193 is on development only and is not released yet.

Tests: src/action/v1/gothru/proxy_test.go and decrypt_test.go (against an httptest GoThru stub), src/utils/gothru_token_test.go, src/routes/v1/gothru_test.go and keycloak_login_test.go.

Deployment dependencies, not verified from the repo: floormap,floormap-dev added to KEYCLOAK_ALLOWED_CLIENTS on the GoThru API, migration 202609250001 applied to the shared DB, and GOTHRU_API_BASE set in the server .env.

Commits: 77ecef5, 16740b9, 2019077
